recentItems.title: For The Love Of Football | NFL Netflix Gameday
recentItems.description:
For the team. For the moment. For the love of the game. Peter Berg directed four NFL on Netflix opening teasers across Netflix's four Gamedays, the first of which kicks off tonight as the San Francisco 49ers face the Los Angeles Rams live from Melbourne. Coverage starts at 6:30 PM ET. Berg also directed, wrote, and produced The Mosquito Bowl, in theaters exclusively October 30 ahead of its November 25 release on Netflix.

Watch on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/82917743
